question: The two contact-angle wall conditions that the anchor cross-validated on a HORIZONTAL plate (angle-driven ghost, wall-order-parameter / Young wall energy) must also reproduce the prescribed Young angle when the same wall is rotated to the other three sides of the box. A 90 deg rotated copy of one physical experiment is the same experiment; if the discretised wall condition is orientation dependent, the anchor's PASS was a bottom-plate-only result.
reference: Young's law cos(theta_Y) = (3 psi_w - psi_w^3)/2 with the wall energy of the model; a rotation of the configuration by 90 deg leaves theta invariant (isotropy of the continuum problem). The reference angle per row is theta_prescribed for the 'contact' arm, and the emergent Young angle of psi_w for the 'wall_order' arm.

arms.contact: angle-driven wall ghost, phi_solid = phi_fluid + cos(theta) 4 phi (1-phi) / W (src/tensorlbm/cac_lbm2d.py)
arms.wall_order: wetting from a wall order parameter psi_w via the wall free energy, theta_Y = acos((3 psi_w - psi_w^3)/2) (independent of any angle input)

predeclared_rules: A row PASSES the accuracy gate iff |theta_measured - theta_ref| / theta_ref <= accept_pct for BOTH independent estimators (circle fit of the level set, spherical-cap area inversion).

A row is MEASURABLE iff the fitted cap apex height >= min_apex_over_width * W and the circle-fit rms <= circle_rms_over_width * W; otherwise it is reported NOT_MEASURABLE and excluded from pass counts (measurement limit, not a boundary-condition result).

MIRROR gate: bottom vs top and left vs right are exact mirror images of one experiment (gravity is switched off, so there is no distinguished vertical); they must agree within mirror_deg. A failure here is a code asymmetry, not a physics limit.
ORIENTATION gate: the axis-rotated pairs (bottom vs left, bottom vs right) must agree within orientation_pct of the prescribed angle.
CROSS-ARM gate: at every (orientation, angle) the two arms must agree within cross_arm_pct of the prescribed angle.

The XVAL PASSES iff every measurable row passes the accuracy gate and all three invariance gates pass over measurable rows. No threshold may be relaxed after inspection; deviations are reported as honest FAIL.
No gravity: gravity is set to zero in every run so that a 90 deg rotation is an exact symmetry of the discrete problem and any measured asymmetry is attributable to the wall condition.

numerics.solver: tensorlbm.cac_lbm2d.CAC2D (D2Q9 conservative Allen-Cahn + HCH hydrodynamics, half-way bounce-back)
